notes.title: Patch Notes – August 12, 2025
notes.content:
Her Place VR – Patch Notes – August 12, 2025


New language: Brazilian Portuguese 🇧🇷
New mission: Strange Sounds
New outfits: Latex Bunny Suit & Latex Deep-V Catsuit


Mission Flow Fixes

Fixed mission flow so the door is now properly locked before introducing yourself to Sophia.


UI & Visual Improvements

Added option to hide completed missions in the mission list.
Adjusted outfit thumbnails; fixed incorrect displays and added missing ones.
Lighting tweaks to improve visibility of Sophia.
Tweaks to the default hair material.
Added new recommended Optimal graphics preset.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where held objects were dropped when opening a door.
Fixed an issue where stepping on a physics object could cause it to disappear.
Fixed an issue where held objects could push the player.
Fixed an issue where some held objects could break Sophia’s physics.
Adjusted Sophia’s door interaction timings.


Thanks for your continued support! 💜 We're committed to making Her Place VR the best experience it can be.  
If you have suggestions or encounter any issues, please share your feedback on the Steam forums.

notes.content:

Thanks for playing and supporting Her Place VR! 💜

notes.title: Patch Notes – July 7, 2025
notes.content:
Her Place VR – Patch Notes – July 7, 2025

🎪 Step into the spotlight – it’s showtime!


 New mission: "Uncover Sophia’s Circus Past" — dive into a personal story and discover a hidden piece of her history  
 New outfit available to unlock: Circus Bodysuit  
 New unlockable achievement: Circus Bodysuit 
 Now you’ll receive feedback when a mission is completed
 Improved flow and structure across various dialogue lines
 Refined grab algorithm while posing Sophia. Interactions now feel smoother and more responsive  
 Fixed a critical bug where the game wouldn’t save after receiving an item  
 The main menu system has been modularized to reduce memory usage (internal system update)  
 Adjustments to Sophia’s skin material for a more natural appearance  
 Added sound effects to UI buttons  
 Default movement mode is now set to Smooth Locomotion  
 Fixed a bug where the Delete Save and Start New Game buttons didn’t work correctly  


Thanks as always for your support 💜 We're working hard to bring Sophia’s world to life — and we’re just getting started.

If you find a bug or have suggestions, let us know on the Steam forums.

notes.title: Patch Notes – June 19, 2025
notes.content:
Patch Notes – June 19, 2025


 Internal system update: Interactive objects (those you can pick up) now support their own dedicated dialogue trees. This allows for more personalized interactions with individual items in future content and opens the door to more complex object-based interactions going forward.

 "Call Sophia" button is now permanently available in the hand menu for quick access, unless Sophia is already nearby or occupied.

 Dialogue tree cleanup: Light reorganization to make sure the right options appear depending on whether Sophia is nearby or not.


Thanks for playing and supporting Her Place VR! Your feedback means everything. 💜

notes.title: Her Place VR – Patch Notes – June 17, 2025
notes.content:
Her Place VR – Patch Notes – June 17, 2025



 New intimacy system (work in progress) introduced to track relationship progression and unlock deeper interactions.
 New mission/dialogue added to unlock the “Friend” level in the intimacy system.
 New contact animation system (Close Interactions mode) implemented to support more meaningful interactions with Sophia. - The first available animation is “Sitting on Lap,” unlocked at the “Friend” level. (More animations coming soon.)
 New contact animation: “Sitting on Lap.”
 New “Do Something Together” dialogue (Close Interactions mode), allowing the player to initiate shared activities.
 Save and load systems updated to support the new features (internal update).
 The gacha ball mission now completes automatically after finding all the hidden balls in the house.
 Some voice lines have been improved.

Thanks for playing and supporting Her Place VR! 💜 We’re committed to making the game the best it can be. If you have suggestions or encounter any issues, we’d love to hear from you on the Steam forums!

notes.title: Patch Notes – June 5, 2025
notes.content:
Patch Notes – June 5, 2025


 The method to temporarily switch VR locomotion modes has been changed: instead of holding the grab button with one hand, players must now hold both grab buttons at the same time. This avoids accidental switching while interacting with objects. 
 New skeleton system implemented for the VR character (internal update).
 Added a new option to adjust the VR neck height in the settings.
 Minor refinements to Sophia’s skin shader for improved appearance.
 You can now exit the pool by touching the pool ladder. While teleport mode still works easily, this provides a proper way to exit when using smooth locomotion.


Thanks for your continued support! We're committed to making Her Place VR the best experience it can be. If you have suggestions or run into any issues, please share your feedback on the Steam forums.

notes.title: Her Place VR – Patch Notes – May 30, 2025
notes.content:
Her Place VR – Patch Notes – May 30, 2025


 Brand-new locomotion system for the VR player, with fully reworked physics: gravity, collision detection, and better height adjustment.

notes.title: Update Notes (May 22, 2025)
notes.content:
Her Place VR – Update Notes (May 22, 2025)

Graphics Improvements


 Default graphics preset is now set to Medium, but you can still adjust higher settings manually in the graphics options menu. 
 Added quick-select buttons in the graphics menu for easy switching between quality presets.


Gameplay & Interaction


 You can now teleport into the pool water (again) — a feature that was previously broken in an earlier patch but is now fixed.
 Gacha balls have been increased in size for better visibility.


Tutorial Enhancements


 Added a new tutorial page explaining how to use the floating in-game menu.
 A tutorial page was added to the main menu.
 The tutorial has been moved to the front of the house.


VR Controls


 Added a dedicated button to reset VR view (reset orientation) — press X or A on Quest, or A on Index.
 On Valve Index, the floating menu button was changed from pressing the thumbstick to pressing the B button (left or right hand).


Thank you for playing Her Place VR!
If you have any questions, suggestions, or encounter any issues, please let us know on the Steam forums — your feedback truly helps us improve the experience.

notes.title: Update Notes for 21 May
notes.content:
Patch Notes 05/21


 Changed activation of smooth movement and rotation to the grab button, allowing for more intuitive control.
 Adjusted grab distance for a more natural and comfortable interaction range.
 Improved teleport navigation to prevent players from teleporting through doors.


If you encounter any bugs or issues, please let us know on the Steam forums.
Thank you for your support — we’re actively working to improve the experience with every update, and we already have more fixes and adjustments coming soon.

notes.title: Critical Bug-Fix Patch – 19 May 2025
notes.content:
Critical Bug-Fix Patch – 19 May 2025

Summary
This update resolves a critical assignment error in the “Find the Clothes (Gacha Balls)” quest, clarifies its in-game description, and tweaks the VR player mesh to stop the camera from clipping.

Details

Fixed a critical error that occurred when assigning the “Find the Clothes” mission.

Updated the mission description for clearer instructions on where to search for the missing clothes.

Adjusted the VR character mesh to prevent camera clipping issues.
